fichas.title: Accessible Housing: Movement Areas and Space Requirements
fichas.summary: Guidance for accessible housing specifies wheelchair movement and turning areas, step-free access, wheelchair parking, bathroom and kitchen arrangements, and space beside beds and cars. The page includes plan and section diagrams illustrating these requirements.
spaces: Rooms and routes within a dwelling
uses: Provide wheelchair turning and movement space
Enable step-free access or access by lift or ramp
Allow wheelchair users to use bathroom and kitchen facilities
Provide wheelchair parking and space for transferring
Provide clearance beside beds and vehicles

dimensions.label: Minimum movement-area width and depth
dimensions.context: Turning place in rooms and other locations specified in the text.
dimensions.ocr_raw: min. 1.50 m wide and min. 1.50 m deep

dimensions.label: Minimum movement-area depth
dimensions.context: In front of the long side of a wheelchair user's bed, cupboards, kitchen installations, the access side of a bath, a wheelchair parking place, and the long side of a vehicle.

dimensions.label: Minimum movement-area width
dimensions.context: Between outside walls and next to steps; the uppermost step tread is excluded from the movement area.

dimensions.label: Minimum movement-area width
dimensions.context: Along furniture approached from the side, beside a non-wheelchair user's bed, between dwelling walls, next to operated equipment, between ramp wheel kerbs, and on routes within a house.

dimensions.label: Maximum door-stop or threshold height
dimensions.context: At the bottom of doors, if a stop or threshold is absolutely necessary.
dimensions.ocr_raw: may not be higher than 2 cm.

dimensions.label: Minimum clearance beside WC
dimensions.context: Movement area to the right or left of the WC; the text also specifies a depth of 70 cm.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must be at least 95 cm wide and 70 cm deep.

dimensions.label: Minimum movement-area depth beside WC
dimensions.context: Movement area to the right or left of the WC.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must be at least 95 cm wide and 70 cm deep.

dimensions.label: Minimum distance from WC side to wall or furniture
dimensions.context: Clearance from one side of the WC toward the wall or furniture.
dimensions.ocr_raw: there must be a distance of min. 30 cm

dimensions.label: Horizontal reach area
dimensions.context: Kitchen; stated as the horizontal reach area for a wheelchair user.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The horizontal reach area is about 60 cm

dimensions.label: Vertical activity range
dimensions.context: Kitchen; vertical activity range for a wheelchair user.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the vertical activity range is 40-140 cm.

dimensions.label: Optimum worktop height
dimensions.context: Kitchen; height should be discussed with the disabled person and fixed to suit the user.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The optimum height of the worktop (approx. 75-90 cm)

dimensions.label: Movement area beside long side of car
dimensions.context: Depth of movement area next to the long side of a car in a car parking place.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A movement area of 1.50 m depth should be provided next to the long side of the car
